Records subject name/SSN/DOB is separate from authorized signer phone/signature
Applicant mailing address item 2 must not be inferred from claimant residence item 3
Contact phone fragments require checkbox selection and possible message-number distinction
Item 3 language preferences are conditional on English not preferred
Basic eligibility/resources have filing-month and other date-window requirements; never substitute current values
Alternate/deferred SSI workflow, not a universal replacement for SSA-8000
